files.description: The draft, whole: proposal.md and each delta spec, under openspec/changes/item-<number>/

content.description: The complete Markdown of the file

resolved.description: On a later round: each gap or finding you were given, and what you did about it. Empty on the first round

about.description: The finding's id, such as S2, or the gap in a few words

how.description: What changed in the draft, or which question you ask instead

questions.description: Only what the owner must decide before the draft can be right. Empty when the decisions settle everything

question.description: One question, worded so that yes accepts the recommendation

why.description: What in the decisions, the pins or a finding leaves it open

recommended.description: The answer you would give, and the reason

summary.description: Two sentences at most, for the item's owner
